text:
Alex: quick standup — yesterday I landed a kernel patch to reduce batch slot contention (PR #4823). Microbench p95 went from ~210ms -> ~165ms for 8-token workloads. Blocker: intermittent KV eviction observed on canary that spikes memory then OOMs. Haven't reproduced locally yet. Today: add eviction-debug logs and run a focused canary cycle.

Priya: nice! can you paste the microbench command you used so I can re-run in perf env? also any env vars/quantization that matter?

Alex: sure — used `./tools/microbench --model=resnet-lite --seq=8 --iters=2000 --batch=4`. runtime flags: `--slot-algo=round-robin --kv-cache=true`. no quantization for that run.

Chen: re: KV eviction — try repro with `KV_EVICT_DEBUG=1 ./deploy/canary-run --duration 10m`. that prints per-shard cache sizes + eviction decisions. also check `kv_threshold_percent` in config (we had it at 72% last deploy).

Jamie: ping on PR #4823 review — left a couple of nits but overall LGTM. Alex, can you address the variable rename I suggested? small but makes logs clearer.

Mara: saw the canary OOM at 03:12 UTC. stacktrace snippet I grabbed: `runtime.oom: alloc failed in shard 5 -> eviction loop` — looks like eviction didn't trigger fast enough. I attached the raw log to the incident thread.

bench-bot: perf snapshot (canary 1725):
```
./tools/microbench --model=resnet-lite --seq=8 --iters=2000 --batch=4
p50: 12ms, p90: 68ms, p95: 165ms, p99: 302ms
KV hit rate: 92.4%
mem usage: 6.1GB -> spike to 9.6GB (eviction lag)
```

Alex: thanks @Mara — I'll correlate that 03:12 spike with the eviction logs once I enable `KV_EVICT_DEBUG`. @Chen can you run the debug canary with `--repro-seed=1234` tonight? if you get a repro throw it into `/tmp/evict-dumps` and ping me.

Priya: I'll check Grafana dash (link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/kv/kv-evictions?panelId=3) to see if there was a slow climb before the spike. Will post any notable alerts.

Chen: got it — scheduling a 1h run at 02:00 PT. will upload dumps to the path if failure surfaces.

Jamie: for PR, I can push the tiny rename fix if Alex is heads-down on eviction. LMK.

Alex: go ahead @Jamie — thank you. I'll follow up with any new logs or a short write-up in the morning async thread. :thumbsup:

Priya: dropping a quick QA ask — can we add a metric for `eviction_latency_ms` to the KV exporter? even a coarse histogram would help triage.

Chen: agree. I can add a basic histogram in the exporter this sprint.

Mara: copying the incident thread ID here: inc-2026-1542 for traceability.

Alex: perfect. closing loop: plan = (1) enable debug logs + run canary, (2) Jamie merges minor PR fix, (3) Chen adds eviction metric, (4) Priya scans dashboards and flags regressions. will report back with repro or next actions by EOD.

bench-bot: scheduled nightly canary (02:00 PT) for 60m; will post summary after run.
